name: Gametape Licks
description: Guitar lessons on chord tones, phrasing, ear training and rhythm. Land the 3rd when the chord changes.

home.title: Land the 3rd.
home.lede: Same lick over C and Cm. The only note that moves is the 3rd. Your ear catches it.
home.seoTitle: Gametape Licks | Guitar Lessons on Chord Tones

method.title: See the 3rd before the change.
method.body: C to F moves the 3rd from E to A. Same move in every key. You spot it while the band is still on C.

steps.title: Chords
steps.body: Type a progression. The diagrams redraw for those chords.

steps.title: Name it
steps.body: The 3rd of C is E. The 3rd of Cm is Eb. One fret.

steps.title: Move it
steps.body: G7 to F7 drops the 3rd from B to A. Slide the shape.

steps.title: Play it
steps.body: Drills at tempo. Land the 3rd on beat 1 of the change.

library.title: One idea. Any key.
library.lede: Start at Lesson 1. Each lesson has a PDF for rehearsal.

about.title: About Gametape Licks
paragraphs: Gametape Licks is chord-tone work. One idea, on the neck, slow enough to see.
Land the 3rd when the chord changes. The same move shows up in the next key.
Free to read and print. Approaches from players I study. No transcriptions.

topics.name: Chord tones
topics.blurb: The 3rd says major or minor. Land on it at the change.

topics.name: Phrasing
topics.blurb: Where the line starts, and where it lands on the 3rd.

topics.name: Ear training
topics.blurb: Name the 3rd before the bar turns.

topics.name: Rhythm
topics.blurb: Put the note on beat 1 of the change.

author.name: Mike Caprio
bio: Mike Caprio plays guitar in New York. He spent 25 years in advertising, media, data and video.
He plays blues and jam-band guitar in The Band Project. These pages are the chord tone and what it does against the chord.
